4793.title: Prepend compensation waits for an unrelated shell commit
4793.rootCauseOneLine: Content growth does not consume the pending prepend anchor; later user scrolling updates its position but retains its old height, so an unrelated shell commit reapplies the prepend delta.
4793.proposedFix: Consume the prepend anchor in the existing ResizeObserver callback as well as the layout effect, before saved-row or bottom restoration; retain in-flight scroll tracking.
4793.caveats: Reproduced the exact production component with controlled DOM geometry in two clean trusted checkouts. Browser Automation could not open because Chrome is absent; no screenshots, macOS gesture reproduction, network pagination, or failed-fetch lifecycle verification is claimed.
